text.en: Verbal morphology in Hokkaido Ainu makes no distinction between finite and non-finite forms, with all verbs exhibiting finite morphology ⟦claim:verb/verb-word-template--verbal-morphology-in-hokkaido-ainu-shows-no-distinction⟧. Ainu verbs themselves do not distinguish continuative and terminal forms, so that the verbal form alone does not indicate whether a clause has ended or continues ⟦claim:verb/verb-word-template--ainu-verbs-themselves-do-not-distinguish-continuative-ren⟧. Across Ainu, no prefix can precede a personal prefix and no suffix can follow a personal suffix, making person affixes diagnostic of the verb word boundary ⟦claim:verb/verb-word-template--person-affixes-diagnostic-of-verb-word-boundary⟧. In a single verb phrase, there is only one main verb, defined as the verb that takes personal affixes ⟦claim:verb/verb-word-template--there-is-only-one-main-verb-in-a⟧. As a general rule, only the main verb takes a subject personal affix, and it always occupies the initial position within the verb phrase ⟦claim:verb/verb-word-template--in-a-verb-phrase-only-the-main-verb⟧. The basic structure of the Ainu verb phrase is [[Verb] { ([Auxiliary verb]) / ([Secondary particle]) ([Transitive verb used as auxiliary]) } ([Adverbial element] [Formal verb])] ⟦claim:verb/verb-word-template--a-verb-phrase-has-the-basic-structure-verb⟧. In Sakhalin Ainu, the verb phrase occurs in six structural configurations: verb stem alone, verb plus derivational affix, verb plus personal affix, verb plus auxiliary verb, verb phrase plus sentence-final particle, or coordinated verb phrases linked by a conjunctive particle ⟦claim:verb/verb-word-template--the-verb-phrase-can-occur-in-six-structural⟧. In the Shizunai dialect, a verb may be expanded into a longer verb expression by adding prefixes, suffixes, pronominal affixes, and auxiliaries ⟦claim:verb/verb-word-template--a-verb-may-be-expanded-into-a-longer⟧. Such verb expressions in Shizunai may be further expanded by the addition of sentence-final forms or suffixes ⟦claim:verb/verb-word-template--verb-expressions-may-be-expanded-by-the-addition⟧.
text.ja: 北海道アイヌ語の動詞形態論には定形と非定形の区別がなく、すべての動詞が定形の形態論を示す⟦claim:verb/verb-word-template--verbal-morphology-in-hokkaido-ainu-shows-no-distinction⟧。アイヌ語の動詞自体には連用形と終止形の区別がないため、動詞の語形自体からは節が完結しているか後続しているかが示されない⟦claim:verb/verb-word-template--ainu-verbs-themselves-do-not-distinguish-continuative-ren⟧。アイヌ語全般において、人称接頭辞の前に接頭辞が現れることはなく、人称接尾辞の後に接尾辞が現れることもないため、人称接辞は動詞の語境界を判定する指標となる⟦claim:verb/verb-word-template--person-affixes-diagnostic-of-verb-word-boundary⟧。1つの動詞句の中には主動詞が1つしか存在せず、主動詞は人称接辞をとる動詞として定義される⟦claim:verb/verb-word-template--there-is-only-one-main-verb-in-a⟧。動詞句内では基本的に主動詞のみが主格人称接辞をとり、主動詞は常に動詞句内の先頭位置を占める⟦claim:verb/verb-word-template--in-a-verb-phrase-only-the-main-verb⟧。アイヌ語の動詞句は基本的に [[動詞] { ([助動詞]) / ([副助詞]) ([助動詞的他動詞]) } ([副詞的要素] [形式動詞])] という構造をとる⟦claim:verb/verb-word-template--a-verb-phrase-has-the-basic-structure-verb⟧。樺太アイヌ語では、動詞部は動詞語幹のみ、動詞と派生接辞、動詞と人称接辞、動詞と助動詞、動詞句と終助詞、または接続助詞で連結された等位の動詞句という6つの構造形態をとる⟦claim:verb/verb-word-template--the-verb-phrase-can-occur-in-six-structural⟧。静内方言において、動詞は接頭辞、接尾辞、代名詞的接辞、および助動詞を付加することによって、より長い動詞表現へと拡張されうる⟦claim:verb/verb-word-template--a-verb-may-be-expanded-into-a-longer⟧。静内方言の動詞表現は、文末形式または文末接尾辞の付加によってさらに拡張されうる⟦claim:verb/verb-word-template--verb-expressions-may-be-expanded-by-the-addition⟧。

text.en: The bound forms that combine with verbs are divided into verb prefixes, verb suffixes, verb auxiliaries, and pronominal affixes ⟦claim:verb/verb-word-template--the-bound-forms-combining-with-verbs-are-divided⟧. The verb stem itself does not change its form according to grammatical person, with only the pronominal affix changing ⟦claim:verb/verb-word-template--the-verb-stem-itself-does-not-change-its⟧. In Hokkaido Ainu, personal affixes occupy the outermost position of the verb word, such that elements occurring outside them are separate words rather than parts of the verb ⟦claim:verb/verb-word-template--person-affixes-mark-outermost-verb-boundary⟧. In Shizunai, pronominal affixes are ordered outside verb prefixes and suffixes, preceding or following the extended verb expression ⟦claim:verb/verb-word-template--pronominal-affixes-bracket-the-verb-stem-and-its⟧. In the Ainu verb complex, personal prefixes occur before all other verbal prefixes ⟦claim:verb/verb-word-template--personal-prefixes-occur-before-all-other-verbal-prefixes⟧. In this prefix sequence, a subject prefix precedes an object prefix ⟦claim:verb/verb-word-template--a-subject-prefix-precedes-an-object-prefix-in⟧. An object prefix does not co-occur with the generalized object prefix, the reflexive prefix, or the reciprocal prefix ⟦claim:verb/verb-word-template--an-object-prefix-does-not-co-occur-with⟧, and these three prefixes are mutually exclusive with one another ⟦claim:verb/verb-word-template--the-generalized-object-prefix-the-reflexive-prefix-and⟧. In Hokkaido Ainu, nominal prefixes and applicative prefixes attach before the verb root; their relative linear order depends on the meaning of the derived verb, and multiple prefixes of the same category can co-occur ⟦claim:verb/verb-word-template--nominal-prefixes-and-applicative-prefixes-attach-before-the⟧. For Saru Ainu, the verb template is reported to contain six affix positions: three prefix slots (applicatives *e-*, *ko-*, *o-*; reciprocal/reflexive/generalized object *u-*, *yay-*, *si-*, *i-*; applicatives) and three suffix slots (number, transitivity, causative *-re*, *-e*, *-te*, *-yar*) ⟦claim:verb/verb-word-template--tamura-six-slot-verb-template⟧. In Southwestern Hokkaido Ainu, no single verb has been attested that fills all six voice affix slots simultaneously while also incorporating a noun ⟦claim:verb/verb-word-template--no-verb-instantiates-all-six-slots-with-incorporation⟧. Bugaeva proposes that the causative suffix *-re*/*-e*/*-te* can appear in two distinct template slots: transitivizing slot V and indirect causative slot VI ⟦claim:verb/verb-word-template--causative-occupies-two-distinct-template-slots⟧. In the verbal suffix template across Ainu, the plural or number marker precedes the causative suffix *-re*, which in turn precedes the iterative aspect suffix *-pa* ⟦claim:verb/verb-word-template--verb-suffix-ordering-number-causative-iterative⟧. The iterative suffix occurs at the very end of the verb word, following other suffixes like the causative ⟦claim:verb/verb-word-template--iterative-suffix-follows-causative-at-word-end⟧. In Saru, the plural suffix *-pa* is placed inside derivational affixes like causative *-re*, whereas the clitic or auxiliary *pa* is placed outside derivational affixes ⟦claim:verb/verb-word-template--plural-suffix-pa-inside-derivational-affixes-clitic-pa⟧. Auxiliary *pa* follows personal affixes, whereas suffix *-pa* precedes personal affixes in Saru ⟦claim:verb/verb-word-template--auxiliary-pa-follows-person-affixes-suffix-pa-precedes⟧. A verb form like *a=e=si-ko-ek-te* 'I made you come to me' consists of six elements and forms a complete clause in a single word, where the only free element is the verb root *ek* and all other elements (*a=*, *e=*, *si-*, *ko-*, *-te*) are affixes, illustrating polysynthesis without noun incorporation ⟦claim:verb/verb-word-template--a-verb-form-like-a-e-si-ko⟧. In Shizunai, most verbs can take one or more prefixes and suffixes, which may change both the meaning and the grammatical properties of the verb ⟦claim:verb/verb-word-template--most-ainu-verbs-can-take-one-or-more⟧. Transitive and intransitive verbs may take one or more verb prefixes directly ⟦claim:verb/verb-word-template--prefixes-attach-to-transitive-and-intransitive-verbs⟧. Verb prefixes have no general sequential ordering rule in Shizunai, but in combinations containing multiple prefixes the order is fixed and lexicalized ⟦claim:verb/verb-word-template--shizunai-prefix-order-lacks-general-rules-fixed-when⟧. The versatility of verb prefixes in Shizunai is limited and their productivity is restricted, appearing almost totally lexicalized when two or more prefixes combine ⟦claim:verb/verb-word-template--in-the-shizunai-dialect-the-versatility-of-verb⟧. As many as five different prefixes may combine before a single verb stem, though two or three is the typical number ⟦claim:verb/verb-word-template--up-to-five-prefixes-combine-before-verb-stem⟧. The prefixes *i-*, *e-*, and *ko-* may each occur twice in a single prefix cluster before a verb, whereas *yay-* and *u-* may occur only once ⟦claim:verb/verb-word-template--prefix-repetition-limits-in-prefix-clusters⟧⟦claim:verb/verb-word-template--the-prefixes-i-e-and-ko-may-all⟧⟦claim:verb/verb-word-template--the-prefixes-yay-and-u-may-only-appear⟧. The prefixes *o-* and *si-* occur much less frequently than other verbal prefixes in the Shizunai material ⟦claim:verb/verb-word-template--the-prefixes-o-and-si-occur-much-less⟧. Verb suffixes in Shizunai join the verb closely without pause or interpolation of other elements to form a single lexical item, whereas auxiliary verbs attach more freely ⟦claim:verb/verb-word-template--verb-suffixes-fuse-closely-unlike-auxiliaries⟧. When a pronominal suffix occurs in an auxiliary construction in Shizunai, it is always placed between the main verb and the auxiliary verb ⟦claim:verb/verb-word-template--pronominal-suffix-placed-between-verb-and-auxiliary⟧. In analytic auxiliary constructions formed with a secondary verb in Shizunai, a pronominal affix may be repeated on the secondary verb ⟦claim:verb/verb-word-template--pronominal-affixes-may-repeat-on-secondary-verb-in⟧.
text.ja: 動詞と結合する結合形式は、動詞接頭辞、動詞接尾辞、動詞助動詞、人称接辞という別個のクラスに分類される⟦claim:verb/verb-word-template--the-bound-forms-combining-with-verbs-are-divided⟧。動詞形態素そのものは文法的な人称に応じて形態を変えず、人称接辞のみが変化する⟦claim:verb/verb-word-template--the-verb-stem-itself-does-not-change-its⟧。北海道アイヌ語において、人称接辞は動詞語の最外郭を占めるため、人称接辞の外側に現れる要素は動詞の一部ではなく別語とみなされる⟦claim:verb/verb-word-template--person-affixes-mark-outermost-verb-boundary⟧。静内方言において、代名接辞は動詞接頭辞や動詞接尾辞の外側に位置し、拡張された動詞表現の前または後に置かれる⟦claim:verb/verb-word-template--pronominal-affixes-bracket-the-verb-stem-and-its⟧。アイヌ語の動詞複合体において、人称接頭辞は他のすべての動詞接頭辞に先行して生起する⟦claim:verb/verb-word-template--personal-prefixes-occur-before-all-other-verbal-prefixes⟧。この接頭辞連続において、主語接頭辞は目的語接頭辞に先行する⟦claim:verb/verb-word-template--a-subject-prefix-precedes-an-object-prefix-in⟧。目的語接頭辞は一般目的語接頭辞、再帰接頭辞、相互接頭辞と同起せず⟦claim:verb/verb-word-template--an-object-prefix-does-not-co-occur-with⟧、これら3つの接頭辞は相互に排他的である⟦claim:verb/verb-word-template--the-generalized-object-prefix-the-reflexive-prefix-and⟧。北海道アイヌ語において、名詞的接頭辞と充当接頭辞は動詞語根の前に接合し、両者の順序は派生動詞の意味に依存し、同じカテゴリーの接辞が2重に付くことも可能である⟦claim:verb/verb-word-template--nominal-prefixes-and-applicative-prefixes-attach-before-the⟧。沙流アイヌ語の動詞テンプレートには、3つの接頭辞スロット（適用接頭辞 *e-*, *ko-*, *o-*、相互・再帰・総称目的語接頭辞 *u-*, *yay-*, *si-*, *i-*、適用接頭辞）と3つの接尾辞スロット（数接尾辞、自他接尾辞、使役接尾辞 *-re*, *-e*, *-te*, *-yar*）からなる6つの接辞位置が存在すると報告されている⟦claim:verb/verb-word-template--tamura-six-slot-verb-template⟧。南西北海道アイヌ語において、6つの態標識スロットすべてと名詞抱合を同時に実現した動詞形は実証されていない⟦claim:verb/verb-word-template--no-verb-instantiates-all-six-slots-with-incorporation⟧。使役接尾辞 *-re*/*-e*/*-te* は動詞テンプレート内の2つの異なる位置（他動詞化のスロットVと間接使役のスロットVI）に現れうるとBugaevaによって提案されている⟦claim:verb/verb-word-template--causative-occupies-two-distinct-template-slots⟧。アイヌ語全般の動詞接尾辞テンプレートにおいて、数（複数）標識は使役接尾辞 *-re* に先行し、使役接尾辞は反復（相）接尾辞 *-pa* に先行する⟦claim:verb/verb-word-template--verb-suffix-ordering-number-causative-iterative⟧。反復接尾辞は語の最後尾に現れ、使役などの他の接尾辞の後に位置する⟦claim:verb/verb-word-template--iterative-suffix-follows-causative-at-word-end⟧。沙流方言において、複数接尾辞 *-pa* は使役 *-re* などの派生接辞の内側に位置するが、接語または助動詞 *pa* は派生接辞の外側に置かれる⟦claim:verb/verb-word-template--plural-suffix-pa-inside-derivational-affixes-clitic-pa⟧。沙流方言では助動詞 *pa* は人称接辞の後ろに位置するのに対し、接尾辞 *-pa* は人称接辞の前に位置する⟦claim:verb/verb-word-template--auxiliary-pa-follows-person-affixes-suffix-pa-precedes⟧。*a=e=si-ko-ek-te*「私はお前を私のところに来させた」のような動詞形は6つの要素からなり1語で完結した節をなすが、自立的な要素は動詞語根 *ek* だけであり、他の要素（*a=*, *e=*, *si-*, *ko-*, *-te*）はすべて接辞であって名詞抱合を伴わない複統合性を示している⟦claim:verb/verb-word-template--a-verb-form-like-a-e-si-ko⟧。静内方言において、ほとんどの動詞は1つ以上の接頭辞や接尾辞を取ることができ、これらは動詞の意味と文法特性の双方を変えうる⟦claim:verb/verb-word-template--most-ainu-verbs-can-take-one-or-more⟧。他動詞および自動詞は1つ以上の動詞接頭辞を直接取ることができる⟦claim:verb/verb-word-template--prefixes-attach-to-transitive-and-intransitive-verbs⟧。静内方言において動詞接頭辞には一般的な生起順序の規則はないが、複数の接頭辞を含む組み合わせでは順序は固定され語彙化されている⟦claim:verb/verb-word-template--shizunai-prefix-order-lacks-general-rules-fixed-when⟧。静内方言における動詞接頭辞の融通性は限られ生産性は制限されており、2つ以上の接頭辞が組み合わさる場合にはほぼ完全に語彙化しているように見受けられる⟦claim:verb/verb-word-template--in-the-shizunai-dialect-the-versatility-of-verb⟧。1つの動詞語幹の前に最大5つの接頭辞が結合することがあるが、通常は2つまたは3つである⟦claim:verb/verb-word-template--up-to-five-prefixes-combine-before-verb-stem⟧。接頭辞 *i-*, *e-*, *ko-* は動詞の前の1つの接頭辞クラスター内でそれぞれ2回現れうるが、*yay-* と *u-* は1回しか現れない⟦claim:verb/verb-word-template--prefix-repetition-limits-in-prefix-clusters⟧⟦claim:verb/verb-word-template--the-prefixes-i-e-and-ko-may-all⟧⟦claim:verb/verb-word-template--the-prefixes-yay-and-u-may-only-appear⟧。静内方言の資料において、接頭辞 *o-* および *si-* は他の動詞接頭辞よりもはるかに出現頻度が低い⟦claim:verb/verb-word-template--the-prefixes-o-and-si-occur-much-less⟧。静内方言において、動詞接尾辞は休止や他の要素の挿入を許さず動詞と密接に結合して1つの語彙項目を形成するが、助動詞はより緩やかに付着する⟦claim:verb/verb-word-template--verb-suffixes-fuse-closely-unlike-auxiliaries⟧。静内方言の助動詞構文において代名接尾辞が現れる場合、常に本動詞と助動詞の間に置かれる⟦claim:verb/verb-word-template--pronominal-suffix-placed-between-verb-and-auxiliary⟧。二次動詞から構成される分析的助動詞形式では、二次動詞にも代名接辞が反復されることがある⟦claim:verb/verb-word-template--pronominal-affixes-may-repeat-on-secondary-verb-in⟧。

text.en: Across Ainu, the arity of a verb phrase inherits the arity of its main verb ⟦claim:verb/verb-word-template--the-arity-of-a-verb-phrase-inherits-the⟧. In Shizunai, closed verbs have no possibility of expansion, whereas transitive and intransitive verbs may be built into longer verb expressions through the addition of pronominal affixes, verb prefixes, verb suffixes, and auxiliaries ⟦claim:verb/verb-word-template--closed-verbs-have-no-possibility-of-expansion-whereas⟧.
text.ja: アイヌ語全般において、動詞句のアリティはその主動詞のアリティを引き継ぐ⟦claim:verb/verb-word-template--the-arity-of-a-verb-phrase-inherits-the⟧。静内方言において、閉鎖動詞には拡張の余地がないのに対し、他動詞および自動詞は代名詞的接辞、動詞接頭辞、動詞接尾辞、および助動詞の付加によって、より長い動詞表現へと構築され得る⟦claim:verb/verb-word-template--closed-verbs-have-no-possibility-of-expansion-whereas⟧。

text.en: In Class III (incorporating) verbs, all subject personal affixes are infixed, whereas only object personal affixes are prefixed ⟦claim:verb/verb-word-template--in-class-iii-incorporating-verbs-all-subject-personal⟧. In Hokkaido complex predicates, Takahashi reports that both verbs contained in the predicate can take person affixes ⟦claim:verb/verb-word-template--in-complex-predicates-both-verbs-contained-in-the⟧.
text.ja: 第III類（抱合）動詞においては、主格の人称接辞はすべて接中し、目的格の人称接辞のみが接頭する⟦claim:verb/verb-word-template--in-class-iii-incorporating-verbs-all-subject-personal⟧。北海道アイヌ語の複合述語では、述語に含まれる2つの動詞の双方が人称接辞を取り得ると報告されている⟦claim:verb/verb-word-template--in-complex-predicates-both-verbs-contained-in-the⟧。

text.en: In Shizunai, verb suffixes attach to transitive and intransitive verbs and comprise adjunct-neutral suffixes, one adjunct-reducing suffix, and adjunct-increasing suffixes ⟦claim:verb/verb-word-template--verb-suffixes-attach-to-transitive-and-intransitive-verbs⟧.
text.ja: 静内方言において、動詞接尾辞は他動詞および自動詞に接続し、副加語中立接尾辞、単一の副加語削減接尾辞、および副加語増加接尾辞に細分される⟦claim:verb/verb-word-template--verb-suffixes-attach-to-transitive-and-intransitive-verbs⟧。

text.en: Except for singular and plural alternations in certain verbs, Ainu verbs do not inflect or conjugate, rendering the term conjugation inappropriate ⟦claim:verb/verb-word-template--verbs-lack-conjugation-outside-number-alternations⟧⟦claim:verb/verb-word-template--ainu-verbs-never-change-their-form-except-for⟧. In Hokkaido Ainu, the plural suffix *-pa* is classified as a formative suffix, and other formative suffixes never co-occur with *-pa* ⟦claim:verb/verb-word-template--the-plural-suffix-pa-is-classified-as-a⟧.
text.ja: 一部の動詞における単数・複数の交替を除き、アイヌ語の動詞は語形変化（活用）せず、「活用」という用語の適用は不適切とされる⟦claim:verb/verb-word-template--verbs-lack-conjugation-outside-number-alternations⟧⟦claim:verb/verb-word-template--ainu-verbs-never-change-their-form-except-for⟧。北海道アイヌ語において、複数接尾辞 *-pa* は形成接尾辞のひとつに分類され、他の形成接尾辞が *-pa* と同時に共起することはない⟦claim:verb/verb-word-template--the-plural-suffix-pa-is-classified-as-a⟧。

text.en: Ainu verbal structure is reported to possess a mixed templatic and scopal organization, in which the suffixed domain is templatic and the prefixed domain is scopal ⟦claim:verb/verb-word-template--ainu-verbal-structure-has-a-mixed-templatic-and⟧. Auxiliary verbs are defined as postverbal invariable particles that attach to verbs to form new verb phrases, and unlike verbs, they undergo no person inflection at all ⟦claim:verb/verb-word-template--auxiliary-verbs-defined-as-particles-forming-verb-phrases⟧⟦claim:verb/verb-word-template--unlike-verbs-auxiliary-verbs-in-ainu-are-invariable⟧. In Saru, genuine auxiliary verbs do not function as independent verbs and, with the exception of *rusuy*, generally do not fuse with the preceding verb into a single verb ⟦claim:verb/verb-word-template--genuine-auxiliary-verbs-do-not-function-as-independent⟧. In Horobetsu, *-ci* precedes person affixes and forms part of the stem, as in *iki-ci=as*, whereas in Shizunai, *ci* follows person affixes outside the verb, as in *hotke=an ci*, reflecting the difference between suffix and auxiliary verb ⟦claim:verb/verb-word-template--horobetsu-ci-precedes-person-affixes-forming-part-of⟧. In Shizunai, verb auxiliaries are treated as optional members of a verb expression ⟦claim:verb/verb-word-template--verb-auxiliaries-are-treated-as-optional-members-of⟧. In that dialect, mode of action, aspect, and modality are expressed by auxiliaries that attach to the verb in its extended form ⟦claim:verb/verb-word-template--mode-of-action-aspect-and-modality-are-expressed⟧.
text.ja: アイヌ語の動詞構造はスコーパル（作用域的）かつテンプラティック（スロット的）な混合組織を持ち、接尾辞部分はテンプラティックであり、接頭辞部分はスコーパルであると報告されている⟦claim:verb/verb-word-template--ainu-verbal-structure-has-a-mixed-templatic-and⟧。助動詞は動詞の後に置かれて動詞句を形成する不変化詞として定義され、動詞と異なり人称による語形変化を全く行わない⟦claim:verb/verb-word-template--auxiliary-verbs-defined-as-particles-forming-verb-phrases⟧⟦claim:verb/verb-word-template--unlike-verbs-auxiliary-verbs-in-ainu-are-invariable⟧。沙流方言において、本来的な助動詞は独立した動詞としての用法を持たず、*rusuy* を除いて原則として先行する動詞と融合して1つの動詞になることはない⟦claim:verb/verb-word-template--genuine-auxiliary-verbs-do-not-function-as-independent⟧。幌別方言の *-ci* が *iki-ci=as* のように人称接辞に先行して語幹の一部を形成するのに対し、静内方言の *ci* は *hotke=an ci* のように人称接辞の後ろに位置して動詞の外側にあり、接尾辞と助動詞の違いを反映している⟦claim:verb/verb-word-template--horobetsu-ci-precedes-person-affixes-forming-part-of⟧。静内方言において、動詞助動詞は動詞表現の随意的な構成要素として扱われる⟦claim:verb/verb-word-template--verb-auxiliaries-are-treated-as-optional-members-of⟧。また同方言において、動作様態、アスペクト、およびモダリティは、動詞の拡大形態に付加される助動詞によって表される⟦claim:verb/verb-word-template--mode-of-action-aspect-and-modality-are-expressed⟧。
